categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in three segments: intelligent terminals, communication modules and industry application solutions, and operation services. Intelligent terminals include smart network set-top boxes, digital set-top boxes, ONU smart home gateways, integrated smart home gateways, smart routers, and smart cameras. Communication modules cover NB-IoT modules, 4G/5G communication modules, and optical modules for 5G networks. Operation services mainly involve smart city projects, technical support, and maintenance services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed 10 core general technologies and 16 core specialized technologies, including embedded software development for multiple platforms (Android, Linux, HarmonyOS), digital TV protocol stack technology, 4K/8K high dynamic video playback, WiFi wireless LAN technology, PON access network technology, NB-IoT low-power communication, 4G/5G cellular communication, and high-speed optical signal transmission. It also possesses 5 core intelligent manufacturing technologies such as automated production lines and automated testing. The company emphasizes R&D in HarmonyOS adaptation, AI algorithms, 5G RedCap modules, WiFi7 routers, and video AI analysis platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's main customers are telecommunications operators including China Mobile, China Telecom, China Unicom, and China Broadcasting Network, serving both domestic and overseas markets. It also serves vertical industries such as energy, finance, healthcare, smart cities, shared economy, and intelligent manufacturing. The company is expanding into overseas markets and non-operator channels through offline and e-commerce platforms.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Huizhou, Guangdong Province. It has subsidiaries and branches in Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Hainan, Hong Kong, Singapore, and other locations. Overseas sales have increased, with products exported to developing and some developed countries. The company is expanding its footprint in provincial markets across China and internationally.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on R&D, manufacturing, and sales of intelligent terminals and communication modules. It collaborates closely with upstream chip suppliers and component manufacturers and integrates supply chain resources to ensure product quality and innovation. It also provides operation and maintenance services downstream to operators and end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding digital home network communication and multimedia entertainment devices, accelerating 5G and IoT product development, promoting HarmonyOS-based products and ecosystem, advancing smart city platforms, developing new energy and energy storage products, and enhancing intelligent manufacturing capabilities. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on 5G RedCap modules, WiFi7 routers, video AI analysis, HarmonyOS adaptation, and smart terminal innovation. It also emphasizes intellectual property protection and collaboration with universities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of intelligent terminals, communication modules, and industry application solutions. The company also earns income from operation services including smart city projects and technical support. Sales are mainly through customized contracts with telecom operators, supplemented by growing sales via offline and online channels. Licensing and investment income from equity holdings contribute marginally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in intelligent network set-top boxes and smart home gateways, holding significant market share with major telecom operators. It ranks among the top ten globally in cellular IoT modules. The company maintains competitive advantages through technology innovation, comprehensive supply chain integration, and strong customer relationships. It faces intensified competition in the domestic operator market and is expanding into emerging sectors like HarmonyOS products and smart cities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.17 billion, a 9.65% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 199 million. R&D investment accounted for 7.51% of revenue. The company’s total assets grew by 6.09% to nearly RMB 3 billion. Despite the loss, the company is expanding production capacity and overseas markets, with rapid growth in communication modules and operation services segments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes technology innovation, especially in HarmonyOS-based products, 5G and IoT communication modules, and intelligent manufacturing. Its products offer high performance, energy efficiency, and integration with emerging technologies like AI, cloud computing, and ultra-high-definition video. The company provides customized solutions tailored to operator and vertical industry needs, ensuring secure, reliable, and seamless user experiences. Its comprehensive R&D and manufacturing capabilities, combined with strong supply chain integration, differentiate it in the competitive market.
